allocation.confidenceRule: 95-percent simultaneous Bonferroni-union Hoeffding intervals across candidates and planned looks

comparisonCaveat: The earlier adaptive64 run used an older collector version and a different configuration-bound rollout identity, so seed streams and observed means are not directly comparable. Candidate ordering overlap is descriptive only.
interpretation: Staged reevaluation and resume logic are test-validated, but the stricter simultaneous intervals retained all candidates and saved no rollouts on this position. The run is not ranker, strategy, or playing-strength evidence. Keep PPO, continuous operation, and trusted promotion disabled.
nextResearchGate: Preserve per-rollout-index outcomes and assess common-random-number paired differences for descriptive variance reduction; then validate any allocation change on multiple frozen development positions before broad label collection. Candidate support and independent source-game coverage also remain limited.
